title: The deploy smoke: the built candidate serves and answers healthy
description: The batch gate's smoke before any deploy: the candidate, built and served in the private trial container, answers GET /healthz?ready&strict with 200, healthy and ready, and with an owner recorded its merge commit is authored 'NAME (Mainworks) <EMAIL>' while the merge writer, mainworks-merge-writer, stays the committer, and what a person reads says Mainworks. Every head a batched merge trial lands is on a candidate this smoke gates.

steps.name: with an owner recorded, the merge commit is authored 'NAME (Mainworks)'
what a person reads says Mainworks, the merge writer commits as mainworks-merge-writer
a repository past the scan budget still scans, so its install can update
the README's commands and links resolve and it recommends a dedicated server without a fixed price
